cv.name: Leah Brandon
cv.title: Registered nurse

cl.p1: I did my second-year placement on your Ward 4B, and on my last day the ward manager asked whether I would come back once I qualified. I passed my final assessments in September – and the answer is yes.
cl.p2: On placement I cared for patients with heart failure, diabetes and several conditions at once, with frequent admissions and close teamwork with the medical team. My final project was on falls prevention. I document carefully and stay calm on nights when two call bells go at once.
cl.p3: I am looking for a ward with a proper preceptorship, and I know you offer one. Full-time rotating shifts suit me. I could start in November.

cl.p1: After nine years on a trauma ward, the last four as deputy ward manager, I still want to nurse – but differently: with more time for each person.
cl.p2: I am a qualified tissue viability link nurse and have managed chronic and post-operative wounds for years, including negative pressure therapy. I have coordinated discharges, agreed medication plans with GPs and taught families how to manage compression stockings.
cl.p3: I have held a driving licence since 2009 and know the area well. Earlies, lates and every other weekend are fine; my notice period is three months.
